newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Oct 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Oct 7.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The government will import 750,000 metric tonnes of diesel oil to meet the additional fuel requirements during the coming irrigation season.

With an alarming fall in ground water level in Dhaka city, the government is considering use of more surface water in meeting household demands. Dhaka's ground water is falling by one metre a year, officials say.
Retired justice Shahabuddin Ahmed may take oath on Wednesday as Bangladesh's new president. Ahmed who headed a caretaker government in 1991 will succeed Abdur Rahman Biswas.
The national committee on insurgency problem in Chittagong Hill Tracts has said the government wants a political solution to the crisis instead through military means or other coercive measures.
Some 68 patients with HIV positive have so far been detected in Bangladesh, a workshop was told. Three people died of AIDS in the country till now.

The government has formed a high-powered body with Commerce and Industries Minister Tofael Ahmed as its chairman to examine the existing industrial policy and recommend update measures to formulate a new industrial policy.
Commerce and Industries Minister Tofael Ahmed will visit China in the third week of this month to woo Chinese investment in Bangladesh.
